definition.html: A type of breast cancer in which the tumor cells do not have estrogen receptors, progesterone receptors, or large amounts of HER2/neu protein on their surface. Knowing whether breast cancer is triple negative is important in planning treatment.  Also called ER-negative PR-negative HER2/neu-negative breast cancer and TNBC.
